name: binnacle
description: A HUD above the Claude Code prompt: what every agent, workflow, background shell and other session is doing right now, with context and quota gauges and a status pane

language.title: Language
language.description: The language binnacle speaks: en, es, or the name of any dictionary you add under i18n/

peersCommand.title: Other sessions command
peersCommand.description: A command printing the other live sessions as a JSON array (see the README); empty turns the rows off

watchCodexLoops.title: Watch for orphaned Codex loops
watchCodexLoops.description: Flag Codex app-server wrapper loops left behind by Zentty and offer to end them

hideModeHint.title: Hide the permission-mode hint
hideModeHint.description: Drop the permission-mode reminder from the hint under the prompt

pinStatusLine.title: Pin a summary line
pinStatusLine.description: With the band off, pin a one-line summary under the prompt; turn it off when settings.json runs tools/statusline.ts instead
